verdict.rationale: Extend publishes a documented public REST API. The evidence shows an API reference with authentication docs, a file-upload endpoint usable for workflows, parsing and evals, and an API quickstart. It also documents sync and async modes on every processing endpoint, webhooks, test API keys isolated from production, official SDKs (pip install extend-ai), and an llms.txt index for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
